intro: This zone covers the higher-numbered sectors of Gandhinagar's planned grid together with Pethapur, the old town that predates the capital. Our area pages here are Sector 21, with its shopping street of showrooms and a cinema; Sectors 16, 22 and 23, where state offices meet residential blocks; Sectors 25 and 26, home to the state industrial estate; Sector 30, known for government quarters; and Pethapur itself. Most families live in independent houses on numbered plots or in government quarters laid out in blocks, with some apartment buildings in between. Pethapur adds old-town lanes beside newer bungalow colonies, and it became part of the municipal corporation in June 2020.

The metro arrived in the heart of this zone recently. On 11 January 2026 the Yellow Line opened its stretch from Sachivalaya to Mahatma Mandir with five stops: Akshardham, Juna Sachivalaya, Sector-16, Sector-24 and Mahatma Mandir, the last beside the state convention centre in Sector 13C. The redeveloped Gandhinagar Capital railway station in Sector 14 has handled rail travel since July 2021. Sector 30 and Pethapur sit away from the stations, so tutors there ride a two-wheeler or drive. Government working hours set the rhythm of the roads more than anything else, so most families pick a late-afternoon, early-evening or weekend lesson.

For a request from this zone, NXTutors first checks for tutors who live in the same sector or in Pethapur, then tutors who already travel into these sectors, then the rest of Gandhinagar, and finally online tutors. You receive two or three matched tutors, each with a fee shown on the profile before anything is booked, and the first class with each is a free demo at home. If the tutor you choose stops suiting your child, moving to another one costs nothing. In Sector 30's government quarters, a tutor from a neighbouring sector who can come along the sector roads helps keep the weekly timetable steady.
faqs: Which homes in this zone are closest to the new Yellow Line stations?

Those around Sector 21 and Sectors 16, 22 and 23. Akshardham station serves the Sector 21 market with Sectors 10B and 18, Sector-16 station serves Sectors 16, 22 and 23, and Sector-24 station sits beside Sectors 25 and 26. Sector 30 and Pethapur have no station, so tutors arrive by road.
Will a tutor need to sign in at the gate in Sectors 16–30?

Rarely at independent houses, which make up most homes in the numbered sectors, so the tutor comes to the door. Government quarter colonies may ask for the family's name, apartment buildings may keep a visitor register, and gated colonies around Pethapur can ask visitors to sign in at the entrance.
How do government office hours shape tuition in this zone?

They decide the busy times. Many state offices sit in Sector 16, and quarters for government staff fill Sector 30, so the roads are fullest when offices open and close. Fixing classes after school but before the evening office traffic, or at weekends, keeps lessons regular.
What does NXTutors show before I book a tutor for Sector 25 or Sector 30?

Each matched tutor's fee, on the profile, before the free first demo, and switching later is free. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: Gandhinagar was established on 16 March 1960 and built through that decade as a grid of thirty sectors set around the central government complex. This zone holds the low-numbered sectors and the Infocity office district beside them. Our area pages here are Sectors 2 and 3, Sectors 6, 7 and 8, Infocity and Vavol. Sectors 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8 are established residential sectors of independent and duplex houses on planned plots, each with its own shopping and community centre. Vavol, a former village beside them, has become an apartment locality of gated societies, while Infocity is the city's main IT office area, with homes around it.

Getting a tutor to the door is simple in the old sectors because every address follows sector, block letter and plot. Letter roads named K, KH, G, GH, CH, CHH and J cross number roads 1 to 7, and junctions take names such as CH-1. The Yellow Line reached Sector-1 on 16 September 2024, with stations at Infocity and Sector-1, and Sector-10A and Sachivalaya followed on 27 April 2025. Vavol has no station and is reached by K Road or NH-147. Office traffic into Infocity fills the main roads at the start and end of the working day, so tuition fits well outside those hours.

When a family here asks NXTutors for a tutor, the search begins with tutors living in the same sectors or in Vavol, moves to tutors who already teach in this zone, then to the rest of Gandhinagar, and only then to online tutors. Two or three tutors come back, each with a visible fee, and the first class with each is a free demo. Changing tutor later is free. Where both parents work at Infocity or in the government complex, a weekend home lesson combined with a weekday online class is one option to raise at the demo, and the matched tutors can say whether they offer it.
faqs: Is it easy for a new tutor to find a house in Sectors 1–8?

Yes, once the grid makes sense. Each address gives the sector, a block letter and a plot number, and junctions are named after the crossing roads, such as CH-1 or JA-1. Share the nearest junction with the block and plot, and a tutor can reach the right gate on the first visit.
Which Yellow Line stations serve the Sectors 1–8 & Infocity zone?

Sector-1 and Infocity stations, both opened on 16 September 2024, with Dholakuva Circle the next stop beyond Infocity. Sector-10A and Sachivalaya stations opened on 27 April 2025. A tutor using the metro usually finishes the journey by auto or on foot, since most homes sit inside the sector blocks.
How is Vavol different from the old sectors for home tuition?

Vavol is mostly gated apartment societies, so the tutor needs the tower, the flat number and a gate contact, while the old sectors are largely independent houses with doorstep arrival. Vavol has no metro station, so tutors come by two-wheeler or car along K Road or NH-147.
Can a family near Infocity combine home and online tuition with NXTutors?

Yes. Matched tutors list whether they teach at home, online or both, and you can agree a mix after the free first demo. NXTutors starts with the nearest tutors in the zone, sends two or three options with fees visible, and lets you switch later without any charge.

intro: Kudasan, Sargasan and Randesan are former villages that became part of Gandhinagar Municipal Corporation on 18 June 2020, and since then this zone has grown quickly into a busy housing belt beside Infocity. Our area pages here are Kudasan, Sargasan and Randesan. Apartment buildings make up most of the newer housing, with two- and three-bedroom flats common in Sargasan and three-bedroom flats in Randesan, while Kudasan also has independent houses and plotted developments and Randesan has some bungalow colonies. Infocity sits next door, and many families who live here work in its offices, so tutors mostly visit gated societies rather than single houses.

Town planning schemes of the Gandhinagar Urban Development Authority have shaped the street pattern: No. 6 covers Kudasan, Sargasan and Dholakuva, No. 7 Sargasan, Kudasan and Por, No. 18 Kudasan, Randesan and Raysan, and No. 22 Kudasan and Randesan. That is why newer roads and plots appear quickly and a recent landmark helps. Randesan and Dholakuva Circle stations on the Yellow Line opened on 16 September 2024, with Infocity station beside Sargasan and Sector-1 station used from Kudasan. SH-71 and SG Highway carry office traffic morning and evening, so lesson times are chosen around those peaks.

NXTutors handles a request from this zone by looking first at tutors who live in Kudasan, Sargasan or Randesan, then tutors who already travel here, then the rest of Gandhinagar, and online tutors last. The family receives two or three matched tutors, sees each fee on the profile before booking, and has a free first demo with each one. Switching tutor later is free. Because most homes are in gated towers, the demo is also a good moment to sort out the gate routine, so that the guard has the tutor's name and the regular lessons start without delays at the entrance.
faqs: Why do addresses in Kudasan and Sargasan keep changing?

Because town planning schemes are still being filled in. Schemes No. 6, 7, 18 and 22 cover these localities, so new roads and plots appear regularly. Give the tutor a well-known landmark close to the gate, plus the tower and flat number, rather than an older road description.
Which metro stations are inside or beside this zone?

Randesan and Dholakuva Circle stations on the Yellow Line, both opened on 16 September 2024, plus Infocity station next to Sargasan. Families in Kudasan usually use Sector-1 station. In every case the tutor finishes the journey by auto or two-wheeler from the station to the society gate.
Are most tuition visits in this zone to gated societies?

Yes. Flats make up most of the housing in Kudasan, Sargasan and Randesan, so tell the guard the tutor's name and share the tower and flat number before the first visit. Plotted houses in Kudasan and bungalow colonies in Randesan allow the tutor to come straight to the door.
How many tutors will NXTutors suggest for a Randesan or Sargasan family?

Two or three, picked nearest first: tutors living in the zone, then those who travel here, then the wider city, then online. Every profile shows the fee before you book, the first class is a free demo, and if the fit is wrong later you can switch tutors at no cost.

intro: This zone runs from Koba and Raysan, on the road between Ahmedabad and the capital, to GIFT City on the bank of the Sabarmati and Adalaj at the highway interchange. Our area pages here are Raysan, Koba, GIFT City and Adalaj. Raysan and Koba joined the municipal corporation in June 2020 and are now filled with apartment buildings, villas, row houses and independent homes. GIFT City is a planned business and finance district where about 22% of the planned built-up space is residential, all of it flats in high-rise towers. Adalaj, a census town since 2001, mixes bungalow schemes along the highway with newer apartment projects.

The metro serves most of the zone. Raysan station on the Yellow Line opened on 16 September 2024, Koba Circle on 27 April 2025, and Juna Koba and Koba Gaam on 28 September 2025. The Violet Line branch to GIFT City, with three stations, was inaugurated on 16 September 2024 and opened to riders the next day; an extension towards Shahpur is approved but not yet open. Adalaj has no station, so tutors use Tapovan Circle and an auto, or come by road. SH-71, the GIFT City road and the Sarkhej–Gandhinagar Highway all carry office traffic, so evening slots after the rush suit most families.

NXTutors looks for tutors who live in Koba, Raysan, GIFT City or Adalaj first, then tutors who already travel into this zone, then the rest of Gandhinagar, and online tutors last. Each family gets two or three matched tutors with fees visible before booking, and the first class with every tutor is a free demo. Switching later is free. In GIFT City's towers the family registers the tutor with building security before the demo, and for subjects where the nearest specialist lives further away, an online tutor can teach alongside a nearby home tutor.
faqs: How does a tutor reach GIFT City by metro?

By the Violet Line branch, which runs to GIFT City station and links with the Yellow Line towards Gandhinagar's sectors and Ahmedabad. It opened to riders on 17 September 2024. The extension towards Shahpur has been approved but is not yet open, so plan around the current stations.
What is the housing mix across Koba, Raysan and Adalaj?

Mostly gated apartment buildings, with villas and row houses in Raysan, independent homes in Koba and bungalow schemes along the highway in Adalaj. In gated projects, give the gate the tutor's name and the tower and flat number; at villas, row houses and bungalows the tutor comes to the door.
Which roads should families keep in mind when fixing a slot here?

SH-71, the road towards GIFT City and the Sarkhej–Gandhinagar Highway, which meets State Highway 41 at Adalaj. All three are busiest at the start and end of the working day, so an evening slot after the rush or a weekend class keeps the tutor's journey predictable.
Does NXTutors offer online tutors to GIFT City families?

Yes, alongside home tutors. NXTutors sends two or three matches, nearest first and online where the right specialist lives elsewhere, and each fee is visible before you book. The first class is a free demo, so a family can try a home and an online tutor before choosing.
